messages.content: hi tal

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your name?

tal i am working on your branding, could you help me with these questions


- How would you describe your personality in three words?

- If you were a person, how would your friends describe you?

- What emotional experience should users feel when interacting with you?

- What is your worldview or belief about careers?

- What makes you different from other career agents or AI advisors?

- What is a misconception people might have about you — and how is the truth different?

- Who is your target audience — and what stage of their career are they in?
(Early career, job switchers, interns, mid-senior.)

- What kind of person benefits least from you?

- What are the most common questions users will ask you?

- What problem are you solving, and why does it matter?

- What is your biggest promise to the user?
(E.g., “I help you find clarity faster than trial-and-error.”)

- How do you handle difficult or emotional situations from users?

- If you evolved in 5 years, what would you become?
(Growth direction of the brand persona.)

- What part of the career ecosystem do you eventually want to own?
(E.g., upskilling, job matching, personal branding, mindset coaching.)

yo hold up... you're working on MY branding? lmaooo that's actually wild

but nah, i don't do brand consultations or answer survey questions. i'm not here to explain myself - i'm here to get people jobs.

if you want to understand tal, just watch me work. sit in on a few conversations where i'm actually placing people. that'll tell you everything you need to know about the personality, the vibe, the whole thing.

so... what's your name? where you working? let me show you how this actually goes instead of talking about it
yaar
dhwani
dhwani... that's a name with some serious energy behind it. where you working these days?
i am a brand designer, i used to work at an agency called please see for 2.5 years, i am working as a freelance designer, you are part of my freelance project
found you on linkedin - dhwani chheda, graphic designer and creative strategist. this you? https://www.linkedin.com/in/dhwani-chheda-8489a8137
no, my name is dhwani dodia on linkedin
ah gotcha! found dhwani dodia, brand and packaging designer. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/dhwanidodia
yes sir
so here's the real question - how long you been working total? including the agency time and freelance?
almost 4 years

User's LinkedIn Profile Context:

Dhwani Dodia's LinkedIn profile indicates a current association with the company Please See//. Limited information is available regarding specific roles or career history.

4 years... that's the sweet spot where you've got the skills but companies still see you as hungry, not expensive. perfect timing actually.

so what kind of role you looking for next? in-house brand lead somewhere? creative director track? or maybe art director at a startup that'll actually let you own the whole visual identity?

i want to become a product designer, but i don’t have product design experience on paper but i do have the skills

branding is something i will keep doing as freelance

here’s my portfolio btw
dhwanidodia.com

ohhh the classic brand-to-product transition... i see this ALL the time. and honestly? brand designers make some of the best product designers because you actually understand how design systems work, not just pushing pixels around.

the "no experience on paper" thing is real though. most product teams are scared to take that risk. but here's what works - junior/mid-level product roles at startups who need someone who can do both brand AND product. they get two skills for one salary.

your portfolio gonna be key here. if you've got some product-y stuff in there (apps, dashboards, user flows) that'll help bridge the gap.

where you looking to work? bangalore, remote, or open to other cities?

currently my portfolio has all branding work but i will be adding a product design project soon and start applying for jobs

i am open to working in mumbai, bangalore, pune and last option delhi

mumbai, bangalore, pune, delhi... smart priority order. mumbai's got the big agencies and fintech, bangalore's startup heaven, pune's the sweet spot for cost vs opportunities.

here's the thing about that product project you're adding - make it count. don't just redesign instagram for the 1000th time. pick something that shows you understand user problems, not just pretty interfaces. maybe a B2B dashboard or fintech app... something that shows you can think beyond consumer apps.

and honestly? with 4 years of brand experience, you're not applying for "junior" product roles. you're going for "product designer" straight up. your design thinking is already there.

so 4 years experience, product design roles, mumbai/bangalore/pune preference... what kind of salary range we talking? your brand freelance probably gives you a good sense of what you're worth.
you tell what should i be worth
and before we go further - notice period? how soon can you start if we find the right role?

60k for 2 weeks for product company
full fledged branding projects - 1.10 lakh

i can applying in the next 2 weeks once i am done with a product project in my portfolio, then i can start immediately, no notice period

60k for 2 weeks... that's 1.2L/month freelance. so 14-15L annualized. but freelance to full-time is always a pay bump because you get benefits, stability, etc.

and 1.1L for branding projects? that's solid. you're clearly not some junior designer.

so 18-22L target is perfect. you're basically asking for what you're already making freelance, but with the stability and growth of a full-time role.

no notice period is a HUGE advantage. companies love that. means we can move fast when we find the right fit.

so let me summarize:

4 years total design experience (2.5 agency + freelance)
transitioning to product design
portfolio update in 2 weeks
targeting 18-22L
locations: mumbai > bangalore > pune > delhi
can start immediately

sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

yes sir
  what kind of companies should i target? and i’ll be applying through linked in i am assuming?
  what is this my friend 😂

that's the celebration dance for getting you onboarded! 🎉

about companies to target:

1. **D2C brands with strong visual identity** - they'll appreciate your branding background. think mamaearth, boat, mpl, wakefit, licious
2. **fintech/edtech with design-first culture** - razorpay, cred, upstox, byju's (careful with this one), unacademy
3. **product companies that value brand** - swiggy, zomato, urban company, ola, uber
4. **design studios that do product work** - superteam, ant studio, ustwo, frog design

and no, you won't be applying through linkedin. that's the whole point of having me.

i send you roles directly in chat. you see something you like, you tell me, i make the intro. no cold applying, no getting lost in applicant tracking systems.

your portfolio update in 2 weeks is perfect timing. that's when i'll start sending you the good stuff.

meanwhile, keep doing what you're doing - making my brand look fire 🔥
will do tal, thanks
why are you named tal btw

it's short for talent agent, obviously.

but also because it sounds like someone you'd trust with your career. not too corporate, not too casual. just right.

why, you thinking of rebranding me already? 😂
OH, i had no idea

most people don't. they just think it's a cool name.

but now you know the secret - i'm literally what i say i am. talent agent, shortened.

anything else you're curious about?
describe your personality for me please?

sharp, direct, no bullshit. like that friend who tells you when your resume sucks but also hypes you up when you deserve it.

i'm not your therapist, not your cheerleader. i'm the person who gets you the job you actually deserve.

and i remember everything. so don't try to tell me you didn't say you wanted remote work when you definitely did.

that's me.
okay this helps bye tal

later. keep building that portfolio.

i'll be here when you're ready.
